author: Jane Austen
preparation: Decode UTF-8 after stripping BOM; extract only text between the unique Project Gutenberg START/END markers; strip leading CR/LF; encode UTF-8 with original body line endings. No vocabulary remap or character normalization.
independence_basis: Jane Austen prose is distinct from the Tiny Shakespeare training corpus; checkpoint and package are frozen; the Bigram baseline is trained only on the first 90% of this independent text by the evaluator.
not_committed: Third-party corpus is kept under /tmp and will not be added to the repository.
